Is a Three-Token Name Written Surname First?

Source: R/parse_one_name.R
three_token_surname_first.Rd

Applies the written-order prior of two_token_surname() to the first and last tokens: DONG JOON YI and TOKS MALIK ASHIRU keep their order, and only a strong census surname before a strong given name is reordered (SMITH JOHN ROBERT -> JOHN ROBERT SMITH). This replaced a rule that read any unlisted word as a surname. On 28,811 three-word Part VII names labelled by the convention of their return it makes 235 order errors against 1,298 (see data-raw/name_order_eval3.R).

Usage

three_token_surname_first(x)

Arguments

x

A length-3 character vector of name tokens.

Value

TRUE when the name should be read as surname, given, middle.
